curation.policy: Keep requirement-linked evidence, live-call ledgers/accounting, output-bound provenance, calibration, compact failure/run summaries, and execution/reservation records; archive bulky raw and superseded payloads losslessly.

archive_limitations: Local and backup copies are on the same machine and are not a durable shared evidence service.
Archived observations remain bound to their original code, configuration and ledgers.
Restoring raw artifacts does not convert historical checks into current system acceptance.
